dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Its name is the "Strongest and Most Steadfast Berserker in All the World."

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: It's a name... the name of my tool.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: "Steadfast" describes its tenacity, "Berserker" praises its strength, and "Strongest" reflects my utmost faith in its abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Names are important vessels of symbolism in Natlan, so my most trusted tool deserves a most glorious name of its own.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Powerful warriors chosen by the Wayob will be granted an Ancient Name, engraved upon obsidian stone.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: This means that the warrior has been acknowledged to have the ability to inherit the legacy of all the heroes who have carried this name before, and will follow the paths of their predecessors to fight for Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: The Wayob has never been wrong. Ancient Names are precious, and each will be bestowed upon a warrior who is worthy of the title.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Speaking of, do you have a tool or weapon that always comes in handy? Why don't you also give it a name? Surely, it's earned one for itself.

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Alright! I'm calling this deck the "Ever Victorious Tyrant"!

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: How!? Ugh, guess I have to give this deck a new name now...

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: Not bad. A concise name, yet filled with ambition. That's a good principle...

dialogues.speaker: Iknal
dialogues.text: I've also got a pretty high-quality hammer at home which I was planning on calling the "Saurian Claw Succulent." Looks like I'll have to reconsider that name now.
